items.title: Integrating construction and solar expansion can reduce disposal and dependency
items.display_title: Integrating construction and solar expansion can reduce disposal and dependency

items.title: Hausberg urbanization in the European Alps
items.display_title: Hausberg urbanization in the European Alps
items.summary: In the Austrian city of Innsbruck, the European Alps are never just scenery. They shape how we live, dream and define ourselves — and how we urbanize. The Patscherkofel — our Hausberg , a personal ‘backyard mountain’ — reveals how a tourism city’s soul climbs higher while its roots shift below.

items.title: Kashan’s path from ancient culture to the modern creative city
items.display_title: Kashan’s path from ancient culture to the modern creative city
items.summary: Traditional architecture in Kashan reflects centuries of adaptation to climate, culture and community life. items.title: Measurements and distinctions, from urban to rural
items.display_title: Measurements and distinctions, from urban to rural
items.summary: Defining cities and measuring what is urban shapes knowledge across fields. But delineations from what is rural and boundaries at the edges of cities or within them are not always harmonized across contexts or paradigms of study, a problem tackled in different ways across this issue’s content.

items.title: Urban climate vulnerability, housing and drug supply
items.display_title: Urban climate vulnerability, housing and drug supply

To address the compounded risks faced by this highly at-risk population, urban climate equity frameworks must integrate attention to the drug supply.
